Spurs erase a 22-point deficit for their 10th straight

Final · Wed, Nov 11 · Chicago

San Antonio beat Chicago 124–119, a 5-point road win. The Spurs move to 10–2; the Bulls fall to 1–9.

2 · The difference

Wembanyama: 32 points, 9 rebounds, 5 blocks

13 of 18 from the floor, two days after scoring 40 at Phoenix.

3 · How it turned

Wembanyama and Harper combined for 50 of 124.

4 · Where it was won
